_comment: Chat models Nexus can call through modules.model_registry (#552). Add an entry to add a model; no code change. cost: free models are tried before paid ones and do not count in the daily budget. A model whose api_key_env is unset is off. Optional per-entry "headers" are sent with every request. The local llama-server is reached through the local_worker delegate, not from here.

models.description: Mistral La Plateforme free tier (rate-limited, 429 falls through to the next model): fast general model. Key from console.mistral.ai.
Codestral code model on its dedicated endpoint with its own key (rate-limited free tier); for code-heavy sub-problems.
Gemini API via its OpenAI-compatible endpoint, free tier with per-project rate limits (429 falls through). Key from Google AI Studio.
Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite via the OpenAI-compatible endpoint: the lightest free Gemini model for cheap high-volume calls.
